**Security: pass-with-notes** at `15ac21166575fdd15d09cd00b8e3ef89abe99524`.

Reviewed the closing-state documentation delta, linked receipts and comment-only Rust change. No exploitable vulnerability or C19/C21 disclosure found.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| 1 | ⚪ LOW | docs/plans/221-seat-provenance/assets/evidence/phase-1.md | 39-42 | Evidence wording says all three verdicts "pass"; their exact result is pass-with-notes | 10/10 |

This is a nonblocking evidence-precision note, not an executable vulnerability. Preserve the qualified result when citing the reviews.

Security output commit `7e537dc8049b198b25a5a95f522f6fe6a9b33194` correctly identifies the whole phase-1 review at `95bbd70a139feafedb16fbca2544383b410d636d`. Its scope is inventory code plus the revised workshop: design-contract closure, not deployed capability enforcement. The evidence explicitly keeps F88 open until phase-2 gates ship (`phase-1.md:63-67`), and workstream 003 s01 remains in-progress. Closing plan 221 does not deliver all of req-10. The three prior LOW inventory-description notes are deliberately deferred to plan 223 AC1 and are not required fixes in this PR.

Local and remote heads agree; worktree clean; PR CLEAN and ready. Exact-head CI [42416288074](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42416288074) and [Delivers 42416288240](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42416288240) passed all five checks. The ddocs step reported UNAVAILABLE, so green CI is not full-schema validation proof. Historical timing claims were not independently reproduced.

No local tests/builds, dependency installs, credential reads, production/pane operations or product edits. No imported-main implementation re-review.
